translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Kik chunyi chandre nikech joma richo
bende chunyi kik gomb gige joma timo gik maricho;
nikech gibiro ner mapiyo mana kaka lum ner;
gibiro tho mi gilal nono mapiyo mana kaka yiende mangʼich.
Gen kuom Jehova Nyasaye kendo tim maber.
Eka inidag e piny kendo inichiem gi mor e lek maber.
Bed mamor kuom Jehova Nyasaye
eka obiro miyi gik moko duto ma chunyi dwaro.
Ket yoreni kuom Jehova Nyasaye;
ket genoni kuome eka obiro timo kama:
Obiro miyo timni makare rieny ka ler mar okinyi,
kendo obiro miyo ratiro mari bed machalo
gi wangʼ chiengʼ marieny odiechiengʼ tir.
Bed mos e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, kendo rite kihori mos;
kik chunyi chandre ka joma moko dhi nyime maber,
ka gitimo chenrogi maricho.
Ritri kik ibed gi mirima kendo lokri iwe ich wangʼ
kik ibed gi ich wangʼ nikech okelo mana rach.
Nikech joma richo ibiro ngʼad kargi oko,
to joma oketo genogi kuom Jehova Nyasaye piny biro bedo margi.
Kinde matin nono to joma timbegi richo ok nobedie;
kata obedo ni unumanygi to ok unuyudgi.
To joma muol piny biro bedo margi
kendo gibiro winjo maber ka gin gi kwe maduongʼ.
Joma timbegi richo chano timo marach ni joma kare
kendo gimwodo lekegi ka gin gi mirima;
to Ruoth Nyasaye nyiero joma timbegi richo,
nimar ongʼeyo ni odiechieng-gi biro.
Joma timbegi richo wuodho liganglagi
kendo gidolo atungegi,
mondo gichiel joma odhier gi jochan piny,
mondo gineg joma yoregi oriere tir.
To ligengligi biro chwoyo adundogi giwegi,
kendo atungegi biro tur.
Gima tin ma ngʼat makare nigo
ber moloyo mwandu mathoth mag joma timbegi richo;
nikech teko mar joma timbegi richo ibiro kethi,
to Jehova Nyasaye tingʼo ngʼat makare malo.
Ndalo mag joma kare ongʼere ni Jehova Nyasaye,
kendo girkeni margi biro siko nyaka chiengʼ.
E kinde mag masira mopore ok ginibed moner,
bende gibiro bedo gi chiemo mathoth ndalo kech.
To joma timbegi richo biro lal nono:
Wasik Jehova Nyasaye biro chalo gi ber mar thiepe manie pap,
gibiro lal nono, adier gibiro lal nono kaka iro.
Joma timbegi richo holo ji gik moko to ok chul,
to joma kare to chiwo gi ngʼwono;
piny biro bedo girkeni mar joma Jehova Nyasaye ogwedho,
to joma okwongʼo ibiro ngʼad kargi oko.
Ka Jehova Nyasaye mor gi yor ngʼato,
to omiyo yorene bedo mopie;
kata ka ochwanyore to ok obi podho;
nikech Jehova Nyasaye omako lwete.
Nyaka aa e tin-na mi koro adoko ngʼama duongʼ
pok aneno ka joma kare ojwangʼ,
kata ka nyithindgi kwayo chiemo.
Kinde duto gingʼwon kendo giholo ji gigegi nono;
nyithindgi ibiro gwedhi.
Lokri iwe timo marach mondo itim maber;
eka inidag e piny nyaka chiengʼ.
Nikech Jehova Nyasaye ohero joma joratiro,
kendo ok obi jwangʼo joge ma jo-adiera.
Ibiro ritgi maber nyaka chiengʼ,
to koth joma timbegi richo,
ibiro ngʼad kargi oko;
joma kare piny biro bedo margi
kendo gibiro dak e piny nyaka chiengʼ.
Dho ngʼat makare hulo rieko
kendo lewe wacho gima ratiro.
Chik mar Nyasache ni e chunye;
omiyo tiendene ok kier.
Joma timbegi richo pondo karito joma kare
ka gidwaro tieko ngimagi;
to Jehova Nyasaye ok bi weyogi e lwetgi
kata yie bura logi sa ma iyalogi.
Bed gi geno kuom Jehova Nyasaye
kendo luw yore.
Obiro tingʼi malo mi omi piny bed mari;
ka joma richo ongʼad kargi oko to ibiro neno gi wangʼi.
Aseneno ngʼama timbene richo kendo makwiny
kadhi maber mana ka yien mangʼich moti e lowo mowinjore kode.
To ne okalo kamano piyo piyo nono kendo ne ok ochak onene,
kata ne omanye to ne ok nyal yude.
Ne kit ngima joma onge ketho,
non chal joma ngimagi oriere tir,
ngʼama ohero kwe nigi geno mar dak amingʼa.
To joricho duto ibiro tieki,
joma timbegi richo ibiro ngʼad ndalogi oko.
Warruok mar joma kare aa mana kuom Jehova Nyasaye;
En e kar pondo margi e ndalo mar chandruok.
Jehova Nyasaye konyogi kendo resogi
oresogi e lwet joma timbegi richo,
kendo owarogi, nikech gipondo kuome.
